blocks.text: There’s often a monthslong lag between the day a Supreme Court ruling is made and when that ruling is made public. The same was true of its June 10 decision acquitting Imelda Marcos of seven counts of graft and reversing the finding of guilt that could have kept the 97-year-old former first lady behind bars […]...
